items.title: Vector Control Expert profile
items.text:
New Zealand has kept
itself safe from the
plague in part by
aggressively controlling
disease vectors.
HOME Wellington
AGE 42

mechanics.effect: Profile sticker. Home Wellington, age 42. No name is printed besides the job on the occupation sticker.
Portrait sticker with no printed text. A bearded person in a red-and-black cap and a dark jacket, looking to the left.

items.title: Vector Control Expert
items.text:
Vector Control Expert. As an action, add a Shelter
to your location (no card required).

mechanics.effect: As an action, add a Shelter to your location. No card is required.

items.title: Create this character
items.text:
Immediately create this character using the stickers
below and add it to the pool of characters.

mechanics.effect: Immediately build this character from the profile, portrait, and Vector Control Expert sticker and add it to the character pool.

summary: Create the Vector Control Expert at once and add that character to the pool. Home Wellington, age 42. As an action, add a Shelter to your location with no card. The parenthetical is italic. Corner badge on the profile is 41. No production cost.
